NEW production animation sheet of the EXACT same character in the approved thumbnail. Reference 1 is character identity; reference 2 is placement guide only. EXACT 4 columns x 2 rows, eight equal SQUARE cells on a wide 2:1 canvas. A dignified Korean founding mother goddess Ungnyeo, serene warm face and long black braided hair, ivory and forest-green ancient Korean robe, gentle bear-spirit silhouette woven into her cloak, holding a small mugwort sprig and garlic bulb close to body; complete right-facing full figure, no unrelated crown. All poses face SCREEN RIGHT, rigid head/body anchor and scale fixed in all cells. Entire subject and all appendages occupy central 60 percent of EVERY cell, at least 15 percent clean transparent margin in every direction. Never overlap borders. Gentle continuous contraction and release of soft body, flowing sleeves/tentacles and attached ribbons; keep rigid head/chest/book anchor fixed. Frames 1-4 basic motion. Frames 5-8 anticipation, distinct physical action, return, and neutral recovery. Gently present the mugwort sprig with an articulated hand, draw it back to chest and settle, cloak trailing naturally. Preserve exact anatomy, colors, costume, number of limbs and species identity. Real different connected poses, no duplicated stills or light-only variation, no per-frame zoom or recentering. True alpha transparency, no background, grid lines, text, numbers, shadows, particles or broad glow. All frame extremities and alpha remain inside cells.
CRITICAL REPLACEMENT: Original was rejected: sprites too big and some cut off at edges. Use 4 columns x 2 rows, exact 2:1 wide canvas, ideally 2048x1024; EACH CELL SQUARE, align exact even grid. All artwork including aura and hair occupies ONLY CENTRAL 50% of each square. At least 25% completely transparent margin on ALL FOUR cell edges. SMALL characters, wide empty gutters, do NOT enlarge. Keep body/head stable and distinct physical animation in cloth, fins, oars, hands. All eight/four poses complete, no crop. No external sparkles, particles or disconnected aura. Preserve approved identity and right-facing.
